newsitem.title: USA: Ameritech to launch new digital service.
newsitem.headline: Ameritech to launch new digital service.

text.p: Ameritech Corp said Friday it plans to launch its new digital cellular phone service, called ClearPath, in the first half of 1997.
ClearPath is based on CDMA (code division multiple access) technology. Ameritech said it successfully tested the service over the last 15 months.

Ameritech said the new service will include enhanced call clarity, better security and fraud protection and a longer battery life. Features such as caller ID and a service that leaves a message on the phone's screen will also be available.
